verdict.rationale: Poly ships a built-in agent that takes plain-language requests to summarize, explain, edit, and organize files, including multi-step read/search/write/organize tasks in a single request. It also supports natural-language search in the app and the CLI (e.g. `poly search "the contract with the March deadline"`), and can be driven from Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code via its plugin and MCP server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language agent works as documented (the evidence is vendor docs only, plus a probe confirming the MCP endpoint is live).
